name: Cumulus
summary: A Publish button that blooms into a sky of rolling clouds, then parts them for a rising sun
about: A blog editor card with a Publish button. Pressing it squashes the button, opens a sky out of the icon and floats a page up into it. Clouds roll past at different speeds while the percentage climbs, then they part, a sun rises behind a tick, confetti flies and the Draft badge turns Live with a pulsing dot. It suits blogs, content tools and any form that saves.
how: Hover: the cloud icon floats and its arrow lifts. Press: the button squashes and the arrow dips.
The sky blooms out of the icon and a small page floats up into the clouds.
Clouds roll past in three layers while the label counts to 100% and a bar fills.
The clouds part, a sun rises with turning rays, a tick pops, confetti flies and the badge turns Live.
The sky folds back into the icon and the button springs back as Update. An empty title makes it wiggle instead.
